# Kyoto 5-Day Low-Walking Base Plan

A single-hotel Kyoto stay works well for your dates and budget. This plan keeps movement light, clusters sights by area, and prioritizes temples, food markets, and easy transit.

# Day-by-Day Kyoto Itinerary and Spend

## Day 1 — Higashiyama Arrival + Gentle Temple Start
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Arrive, check in, rest, and take a short neighborhood walk near your hotel base.
- Afternoon: Kiyomizu-dera area with taxi or bus access; focus on the main temple grounds and viewpoints.
- Evening: Dinner in Gion or Pontocho; keep it simple with a set meal and an early night.
- Estimated spend for 2 adults: **JPY 30,000**
- Main costs: hotel share, local transit, entry fees, dinner

## Day 2 — Nishiki Market + Central Kyoto Temples
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/shop.svg
- Morning: Nishiki Market for breakfast bites, snacks, and souvenirs; stay flexible and seated-friendly.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/e5/A_store_at_Nishiki_market%2C_Kyoto%2C_Japan.jpg Alt=Morning: Nishiki Market for breakfast bites, snacks, and souvenirs; stay flexible and seated-friendly, Kyoto, Japan
- Afternoon: Nijo Castle or nearby temple stop, using taxi for the easiest transfer.
- Evening: Casual izakaya or noodle dinner near downtown Kyoto.
- Estimated spend for 2 adults: **JPY 34,000**
- Main costs: food market sampling, admissions, lunch, dinner
Media: Alt=Main costs: food market sampling, admissions, lunch, dinner, Kyoto, Japan

## Day 3 — Arashiyama Scenic Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- Morning: Travel early to Arashiyama; visit Tenryu-ji and the bamboo grove at a relaxed pace.
- Afternoon: Riverside café break, optional short boat ride or train ride back if energy is low.
- Evening: Return to central Kyoto for an easy dinner near the hotel.
- Estimated spend for 2 adults: **JPY 36,000**
- Main costs: transport, temple entry, café stops, dinner

## Day 4 — Northern Temples + Tea Breaks
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Kinkaku-ji or another major northern temple, using taxi to reduce walking.
- Afternoon: Peaceful tea stop and a second nearby temple or shrine if you still have energy.
- Evening: Kyoto-style kaiseki-lite or a refined set dinner close to your base.
- Estimated spend for 2 adults: **JPY 33,000**
- Main costs: transport, admissions, tea, dinner

## Day 5 — Slow Checkout + Last Market Stops
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/calendar.svg
- Morning: Pack, check out, and leave luggage with the hotel if needed.
- Afternoon: Final visit to a nearby temple, department store food hall, or souvenir market.
- Evening: Departure day meal and transfer to your next stop or airport link.
- Estimated spend for 2 adults: **JPY 22,000**
- Main costs: lunch, transit, souvenirs, light snacks

# Budget Breakdown and Daily Cost Plan

| Category | 5-Day Estimate (JPY) | Share of Budget |
|---|---:|---:|
| Hotel base for 4 nights | 72,000 | 40% |
| Food and drinks | 46,000 | 26% |
| Local transport | 22,000 | 12% |
| Temple and attraction fees | 18,000 | 10% |
| Snacks, tea, souvenirs | 12,000 | 7% |
| Buffer / flexibility | 10,000 | 5% |
| Total | **180,000** | **100%** |
